notes.subject: אתי
notes.rationale: את H854 preposition 'with me', not the direct-object marker; rendered 'miegħi' without ⟨את⟩

notes.subject: jibqa' joqgħod
notes.rationale: תלין literally 'passes the night' — the error lodges overnight, permanently, with Job

notes.subject: iż-żball tiegħi jikkawżani biss
notes.rationale: reading with BSB: the error concerns me alone, an implicit rebuke of the friends' intrusion

translation: U jekk tabilħaqq tlift triqti, iż-żball tiegħi jibqa' joqgħod ⟨את⟩ miegħi.
